definitions.short: a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl
definitions.full: H8464. tachmas תַּחְמָס noun [masculine] name of male ostrich , according to Bo ii.830 Thes (Thes derives from violence of this bird, compare Arabic violence , also ostrich ; other conjectures are: owl ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ; swallow , Saad: see also Kn in Di) — mentioned as unclean Lev 11:16 (P) Deut 14:15 .

occurrences.englishText: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
